name: 13_exact_threshold_boundary
description: Interior nonspeech near the quarter-second interior threshold (2*0.25+0.1 = 0.6s): the 1.6-1.0 span is ~1 ULP ABOVE 0.6, so the 0.25s collar CARVES (0.1s scored middle) while the 0.5s collar (threshold 1.1) MERGES it to a whole collar -- exercises the carve-vs-merge BRANCHES. It does NOT distinguish >= from > (the span is strictly above 0.6 either way); the >= inclusivity rests on the perl's hex-verified threshold bit-identity, not this golden.
